_comment: SSOT for [card-budget] (check_orchestration.py rule 13). Snippet/shared-doc files cited by >=3 distinct skills+agents that already exceeded the 4096B default cap BEFORE wave 7 (PR7, M9) touched anything, EXCLUDING wave 7's own 13 inverted files, PLUS a second block (below the marker) added AFTER each of those 13 files was trimmed and its post-trim actual size recorded as its own permanent budget - this second block is added incrementally per file as the wave lands, never regenerated wholesale. The rule fires only when a listed file GROWS past its budget here, or a file NOT listed enters the >=3-citer set above the default 4096B cap.
_comment_declared: An entry here is also a DECLARATION that the file is a hot contract, and that declaration is itself an entry ticket: check_orchestration.py measures every listed path wherever it lives, not only the snippets/ + skills/_shared/ corpus the >=3-citer heuristic scans. That is the ONLY way a top-level skills/<name>/SKILL.md runtime contract can be capped - its basename SKILL.md is shared by every skill, so the citer count cannot see it. Keep every budget equal to the file's actual size when it was recorded: a budget above the real size silently hands back the space a trim just reclaimed.
